This gate attributes only the GUARD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED mechanism; co-occurring Gate2B2 deficits remain separate and are not repaired or causally collapsed.

pre_freeze_structural_knowledge.guard_scope_persistence_lemma: Under frozen observability_overlay 77be5ea... and overlay_graph 9975fe5..., a frozen GUARD_COMPARISON anchor is initially materialized without attrs.scope; OverlayGraph.node content-addresses attrs rather than merging them; later construction reuses the anchor id and does not rematerialize it with scope; edge/evidence attachment and final validation do not backfill scope. Therefore that exact anchor cannot acquire scope later.
pre_freeze_structural_knowledge.adapter_scope_consumption_rule: Frozen primary_adapter c1b5d5e... reads guard_scope only from the exact GUARD_COMPARISON anchor node attrs.scope and appends GUARD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED when that value is absent/falsey; no name-based or path-scope fallback exists.
pre_freeze_structural_knowledge.path_scope_rule: Frozen path_observability 6eae340... records structured path states with scope and STRUCTURED_BRANCH transitions, computes effective_guard_observability, and records control-scope completeness. These already-frozen outputs may therefore test whether material structured scope was uniquely available in the primary evidence substrate.
pre_freeze_structural_knowledge.hypothesis_not_result: Some, all, or none of the 39 known GUARD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED cases may satisfy the preregistered carrier-survival predicate. The 39-case outcome is unknown at protocol freeze and no all-cases attribution is assumed.

deterministic_predicates.P_GATE2B2_SCOPE_DEFICIT: The exact Gate2B2 row contains primitive atom prefix GUARD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED and an exact F_UNRESOLVED:GUARD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED admission reason.
deterministic_predicates.P_TRACE_COMPLETE: Both exact manifest-bound overlay/path members exist uniquely, byte digests match, schemas validate, and path.base_overlay_digest_sha256 equals overlay.overlay_digest_sha256.
deterministic_predicates.P_ANCHORED_GUARD_EXISTS_UNIQUE: Exactly one overlay node has attrs.anchor_role == GUARD_COMPARISON.
deterministic_predicates.P_ANCHORED_GUARD_SCOPE_ABSENT: For that exact anchored guard node, attrs.scope is missing, null, or the empty string.
deterministic_predicates.P_EFFECTIVE_GUARD_ASSOCIATION_UNIQUE: Let E be path.effective_guard_observability. If E.form==DIRECT_CONTROL, require nonempty E.guard_id equal to the anchored guard id and require that guard to be branch-bearing via GUARDS edges with both boolean polarities. If E.form==HELPER_CONTROL, independently replay only the frozen graph-reachability relation defined by path_observability 6eae340...: from the transported anchored guard traverse DERIVES edges only when derivation is one of comparison_result_to_return,function_return_to_call_result,call_result_to_assignment,call_result, and traverse BINDS_TO only when binding==call_argument_to_parameter; collect COMPARES targets that are branch-bearing. Require exactly one reachable consumer, no disallowed transform encountered, and require it to equal nonempty E.guard_id. Any other E.form, empty guard_id, disagreement, ambiguity, or bad transform makes this predicate false.
deterministic_predicates.P_UPSTREAM_STRUCTURED_SCOPE_UNIQUE: Using only frozen path.path_states, select states whose transition.kind==STRUCTURED_BRANCH and transition.guard_id equals the effective guard id proven above. Require at least one state, exactly one nonempty state.scope value, exactly one nonempty transition.statement_span value, branch polarities collectively exactly {true,false}, path.control_scope_completeness[that scope]==COMPLETE, and path.material_control_complete==true. Also require exactly one overlay.control_completeness row for that scope with status==COMPLETE.
deterministic_predicates.P_NO_EARLIER_SCOPE_AMBIGUITY: P_EFFECTIVE_GUARD_ASSOCIATION_UNIQUE and P_UPSTREAM_STRUCTURED_SCOPE_UNIQUE are true, with no conflicting nonempty structured scope or statement span among the selected branch states.
deterministic_predicates.P_GUARD_SCOPE_CARRIER_SURVIVAL_FAILURE: P_GATE2B2_SCOPE_DEFICIT AND P_TRACE_COMPLETE AND P_ANCHORED_GUARD_EXISTS_UNIQUE AND P_ANCHORED_GUARD_SCOPE_ABSENT AND P_EFFECTIVE_GUARD_ASSOCIATION_UNIQUE AND P_UPSTREAM_STRUCTURED_SCOPE_UNIQUE AND P_NO_EARLIER_SCOPE_AMBIGUITY.

first_match_order.rule: P_TRACE_COMPLETE but P_GATE2B2_SCOPE_DEFICIT is false, or the unique exact anchor carries a nonempty scope despite the frozen Gate2B2 GUARD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED observation and exact frozen adapter-consumption rule.
P_TRACE_COMPLETE and not FROZEN_CHAIN_INCONSISTENT, but P_ANCHORED_GUARD_EXISTS_UNIQUE or P_EFFECTIVE_GUARD_ASSOCIATION_UNIQUE is false.
P_TRACE_COMPLETE, exact anchor is unique and scope-absent, effective-guard association is unique, but P_UPSTREAM_STRUCTURED_SCOPE_UNIQUE or P_NO_EARLIER_SCOPE_AMBIGUITY is false.
Deterministic residue for a trace-complete case satisfying none of the preceding classes; no OTHER bucket may be invented later.
